audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows contradicted their own whys in both layers. Row 1 read K'Sante though whys[1] says 'neither of us owns this stage cleanly'; rows 3 and 4 read Skill though whys[3] and whys[4] hand him both stages; rows 5 and 6 read K'Sante though whys[5] says the win rate holds and whys[6] opens 'Even late'.
audit.why: Path Maker's charge takes reduced damage and its dash stuns, and the 2-stack Q pull answers your combo through 4-5; All Out at 6 isolates you. By first item your Bami line stabilises the lane again, and late you stop duelling entirely.
audit.corrected: Row 1 -> Skill, row 3 -> K'Sante, row 4 -> K'Sante, row 5 -> Skill, row 6 -> Skill. Matched full+content pairs, one atomic group. Existing ratings already fit the corrected sides, so they are untouched. Matches the packet chart and the mirror's stated chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage was framed as an 'All Out cooldown window', including levels 2-5 when he has no ultimate at all, and the first-item row credited Heartsteel rather than the Bami/sustain line the content layer actually recommends.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80s and only exists from 6. The stages that decide this lane are his Path Maker (14/13/12/11/10s), the 2-stack Ntofo Strikes pull on a 3.5s Q, and his 2-item scaling.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the right abilities written into phases[1].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, phases[5].why, phases[6].why, tldr, winCon, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (1) The page repeatedly calls his Q a knockup — Riot's text says the 2-stack shockwave PULLS enemies in. A pull and a knockup demand opposite positioning. (2) Path Maker was described only as a 'block' and a 'tank-up'; it actually takes reduced damage while charging and then dashes to knock back and stun, and when All Out it stops knocking back or stunning altogether.
audit.why: Riot Q text: 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.' Riot W text: 'charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning ... When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.' The All Out clause is a real trade-off worth knowing: his ult buys damage at the cost of his stun.
audit.corrected: Stated in report[5].t, report[11].t and phases[3].why. Several 'Q knockup' strings are under 25 characters (dosFull[2].t 'Dodge his Q knockups', dontsFull[0].t 'Get walled by his Q') and the applier skips those, so they are reported in notes instead.
